Then reason: A and B are both located near 30°N, so the difference in natural landscapes between the two places should not mainly be attributed to heat differences caused by latitude; the pressure distribution in the figure reflects that different regions are affected by different wind directions, moisture transport, and precipitation conditions, which belongs to the effect of atmospheric circulation. method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中甲、乙都位于30°N附近，甲在约30°经度处，乙在约120°经度处；沿线气压由两端约1004 hPa向中部约996 hPa变化，说明该月存在明显的气压场和风场差异。再推理：由于题目比较的是同一纬度附近两地，自然景观差异不能主要归因于纬度热量差异；图示气压差异对应不同的风向、湿度输送和降水条件，而这些属于大气环流影响。因此甲、乙自然景观差异明显的主要原因是大气环流。
